about.title: About Home Equity Loan Calculator - Fixed-Rate Home Equity Tool
about.description: The Home Equity Loan Calculator is a comprehensive home financing tool designed to help homeowners calculate monthly payments, total costs, and borrowing capacity for fixed-rate home equity loans. This calculator helps you determine how much equity you can access, monthly payment amounts, and total interest costs over the loan term. Whether you're funding home improvements, consolidating debt, or covering major expenses, this tool provides accurate projections for home equity loan scenarios.

faq.q: How much can I borrow with a home equity loan?
faq.a: Most lenders allow you to borrow up to 80-85% of your home's value minus your existing mortgage balance. For example, if your home is worth $400,000 and you owe $200,000, you might qualify for up to $120,000-$140,000.

faq.q: What's the difference between a home equity loan and HELOC?
faq.a: A home equity loan provides a lump sum with fixed payments and rates. A HELOC is a line of credit with variable rates that you can draw from as needed. Home equity loans offer payment predictability, while HELOCs provide flexibility.

faq.q: Are home equity loan interest payments tax deductible?
faq.a: Interest may be tax deductible if you use the funds to buy, build, or substantially improve your home. The deduction is limited to interest on up to $750,000 of qualified residence loans. Consult a tax professional for specific guidance.

faq.q: What are typical home equity loan rates and terms?
faq.a: Home equity loan rates are typically 1-2% higher than first mortgage rates but lower than credit cards or personal loans. Terms usually range from 5-30 years, with 10-15 year terms being most common.
